articles.summary: Tenable® Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: TENB), the exposure management company , today announced the appointment of Charlie Bell to its Board of Directors. A seasoned technology executive with nearly four decades of hands-on software engineering and operational leadership, Bell brings deep expertise in building and scaling complex cloud systems to Tenable’s board as the company continues to advance its AI-powered exposure management platform.
articles.title: Tenable Appoints Industry Veteran Charlie Bell to Board of Directors
